annotations.title: Look up a crystal by number, degree or name

description: Looks up Costelloe's crystal astrology table by number (1-360, the book's astrological numerology, e.g. a house or street number), by tropical degree ("Libra 2") or by crystal name. Returns the degree, number, birthdays, page locator, crystal-name numerology, the Karmic Condition/Focus/Quest neighbours, and handling, water, price and availability facts with a safe stand-in where needed.
